facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that in 2023 the government transferred to Camtel an overhead fibre-optic network of about 812km on electricity poles along the southern interconnected grid, which serves major cities including Douala and Yaounde, adding to Camtel's terrestrial fibre network of about 12,000km.

CMR.note: No share of people using the internet stated.
Nothing stated on local government offices.
The MoU is between two Cameroonian state firms; no other African country named.
